description: Host Hotels & Resorts, L.P. is the largest publicly traded lodging REIT, with a geographically diverse portfolio of luxury and upper-upscale hotels, and as of February 20, 2026 its consolidated lodging portfolio consists of 76 primarily luxury and upper-upscale hotels containing approximately 41,700 rooms, with substantially all located in the United States, five of the hotels being located outside the U.S. in Brazil and Canada, in addition to owning non-controlling interests in seven domestic joint ventures that focus on the lodging industry. Host Inc. was incorporated as a Maryland corporation in 1998 and operates as a self-managed and self-administered REIT, owning hotels and conducting operations through Host L.P., of which it is the sole general partner and of which it holds approximately 99 percent of the partnership interests as of December 31, 2025.
